title: Tutor Session Correction Theme Rank
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:tutor feedback_theme=*
| stats count as correction_notes by feedback_theme
| sort - correction_notes
description: Ranks feedback theme by correction notes volume for tutor feedback.
value: Volume rankings show which feedback theme are producing the most activity, demand, or friction inside tutor feedback.
implementation: Capture each correction notes as a `language:tutor` event and normalize `feedback_theme` so the totals are comparable.
visualization: Bar chart of correction notes volume by feedback theme.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which feedback theme show up the most in tutor feedback so you know where the busiest areas are.
